diagnostics.title: Hardware check
diagnostics.description: Run every llama.cpp operation on your devices and check the results are correct. Useful when a model fails to load or gives bad output.
diagnostics.verdictPassedDetail: Every operation returned the right answer.
diagnostics.verdictFallbackDetail_one: 1 operation type is not fully implemented here. If a model uses it, that part of the work runs on the CPU instead. A model that does not use it is unaffected.
diagnostics.verdictFallbackDetail_other: {{count}} operation types are not fully implemented here. If a model uses one, that part of the work runs on the CPU instead. A model that does not use them is unaffected.
diagnostics.verdictFailedDetail_one: 1 operation returned the wrong answer. A model using it will produce bad output or fail to load.
diagnostics.verdictFailedDetail_other: {{count}} operations returned the wrong answer. A model using them will produce bad output or fail to load.
diagnostics.verdictCrashedDetail: The check process died on this device. A model would stop the same way.
diagnostics.verdictUnknownDetail: No results for this device yet.
diagnostics.fullConfirmBody: The full check tests every operation. It takes 15 minutes or more per device and uses every CPU core.
diagnostics.fullConfirmDriver: On Windows, a long GPU test can reset the display driver, which would interrupt anything you have loaded.
diagnostics.fullConfirmLoaded_one: 1 model is loaded and will compete for memory.
diagnostics.fullConfirmLoaded_other: {{count}} models are loaded and will compete for memory.
diagnostics.casesTruncated: Only the first {{count}} cases that passed or ran on the CPU were kept. Every failure is listed.
diagnostics.groupMatrixMathDetail: The core calculation of every model. Most of the work happens here.
diagnostics.groupAttentionDetail: How the model decides which earlier words matter for the next one.
diagnostics.groupNormalizationDetail: Keeps numbers in a workable range between layers.
diagnostics.groupPositionalDetail: How the model tracks the order words came in.
diagnostics.groupConvolutionDetail: Used by image and audio models, not by plain chat models.
diagnostics.groupActivationDetail: The small shaping step applied after each layer.
diagnostics.groupMemoryDetail: Moving numbers around without changing them.
diagnostics.groupOtherDetail: Everything that does not fit the groups above.
diagnostics.quantizedDetail: Every model you download is compressed, so a failure here affects all of them.
diagnostics.busyBlocked: The check is unavailable while a model is loading or replying. Wait for it to finish, then run the check.
diagnostics.busyDuringRun: A model started working during this check. Results are still accurate, but the timings are not, and a failure here may be caused by competing for memory.
diagnostics.verdictInconclusiveDetail_one: 1 part of the check matched no test on this build of llama.cpp, so it was not checked. Run the full check to cover it.
diagnostics.verdictInconclusiveDetail_other: {{count}} parts of the check matched no test on this build of llama.cpp, so they were not checked. Run the full check to cover them.
diagnostics.verdictPartialDetail: This check stopped before every part of it had run on this device, so the parts that did pass are not the whole answer. Run it again to finish.
diagnostics.inconclusiveNotice: Some parts of this check tested nothing, so it is not a clean result. Run the full check to cover them.
diagnostics.suggestionTryAnotherDevice: Run your models on {{alternative}} instead of {{device}}.
diagnostics.suggestionTryAnotherDeviceDetail: {{device}} returned wrong answers, and {{alternative}} passed every check. Set the device in the model's settings.
diagnostics.suggestionReduceGpuLayers: Put fewer layers on {{device}}, or run on the processor.
diagnostics.suggestionReduceGpuLayersDetail_one: 1 part of the check stopped the test process on this device, which is what running out of video memory or losing the driver looks like.
diagnostics.suggestionReduceGpuLayersDetail_other: {{count}} parts of the check stopped the test process on this device, which is what running out of video memory or losing the driver looks like.
diagnostics.suggestionDisableFlashAttention: Turn flash attention off for models on {{device}}.
diagnostics.suggestionDisableFlashAttentionDetail_on: 1 attention check returned the wrong answer. Flash attention is optional, and turning it off uses the slower path that passed.
diagnostics.suggestionDisableFlashAttentionDetail_ot: {{count}} attention checks returned the wrong answer. Flash attention is optional, and turning it off uses the slower path that passed.
diagnostics.suggestionUseAnotherQuantization: Try a model with a different compression on {{device}}.
diagnostics.suggestionUseAnotherQuantizationDetail_o: 1 failure is in a compressed-weight operation while the uncompressed ones passed, so a differently compressed download may work.
{{count}} failures are in compressed-weight operations while the uncompressed ones passed, so a differently compressed download may work.
diagnostics.suggestionExpectCpuFallback: Some work may run on the CPU instead of {{device}}.
diagnostics.suggestionExpectCpuFallbackDetail_one: 1 operation type is not fully implemented on {{device}}. Whether this costs you any speed depends on the model: one that never uses it runs at full speed.
diagnostics.suggestionExpectCpuFallbackDetail_other: {{count}} operation types are not fully implemented on {{device}}. Whether this costs you any speed depends on the model: one that never uses them runs at full speed.
diagnostics.suggestionRerunWholeCheckDetail_one: 1 part of this check matched no test, so it was not checked at all. The full check does not narrow anything.
diagnostics.suggestionRerunWholeCheckDetail_other: {{count}} parts of this check matched no test, so they were not checked at all. The full check does not narrow anything.
diagnostics.verdictCpuUnsupportedDetail: Every operation your models need returned the right answer. The check also tries combinations no model builds, such as training-only operations, and those have no CPU version; that is normal on every machine.

llamacpp_env.title: Environmental variables
llamacpp_env.description: Environmental variables for llama.cpp(KEY=VALUE), separated by ';'

models_max.title: Max Concurrently Loaded Models
models_max.description: Maximum number of models the router will keep loaded at once. 0 = unlimited.

timeout.title: Timeout for llamacpp
timeout.description: Llamacpp connection and load timeout in seconds

fit.title: Fit (auto-adjust to device memory)
fit.description: Whether to adjust unset arguments to fit in device memory ('on' or 'off'). (env: LLAMA_ARG_FIT)

fit_target.title: Fit Target per Device (MiB)
fit_target.description: Target margin per device for fit, comma-separated list of MiB values. Single value is broadcast across all devices. (env: LLAMA_ARG_FIT_TARGET)

fit_ctx.title: Fit Minimum Context Size
fit_ctx.description: Minimum context size (tokens) that can be set by the auto-fit option.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Number of threads to use during generation (-1 for logical cores).

threads_batch.title: Threads (Batch)
threads_batch.description: Number of threads for batch and prompt processing (default: same as Threads).

ctx_shift.title: Context Shift
ctx_shift.description: Allow model to cut text in the beginning to accommodate new text in its memory

n_predict.title: Max Tokens to Predict
n_predict.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (-1 = infinity).

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Logical maximum batch size for processing prompts.

ubatch_size.title: uBatch Size
ubatch_size.description: Physical maximum batch size for processing prompts.

n_cpu_moe.title: MoE Layers on CPU
n_cpu_moe.description: Keep the Mixture-of-Experts weights of the first N layers in CPU memory. Lets a large MoE model fit in limited VRAM. 0 disables it.

n_cpu_ffn.title: Dense FFN Layers on CPU
n_cpu_ffn.description: Keep the dense feed-forward weights of the first N layers in CPU memory. The counterpart of the MoE setting above, for dense models. 0 disables it.

no_kv_offload.title: Disable KV Cache Offload
no_kv_offload.description: Keep the KV cache in system RAM instead of GPU memory. Useful when VRAM is scarce, at the cost of speed.

device.title: Devices for Offload
device.description: Comma-separated accelerators to offload to, named as in the detected hardware list. Leave empty to use every available accelerator, or set "none" to disable offload entirely.

split_mode.title: GPU Split Mode
split_mode.description: How to split the model across multiple GPUs.

main_gpu.title: Main GPU Index
main_gpu.description: The GPU to use for the model (split-mode=none) or intermediate results (split-mode=row).

tensor_split.title: Tensor Split
tensor_split.description: Comma-separated proportions for splitting the model across devices, e.g. "3,1". Leave empty for an even split.

no_op_offload.title: Disable Op Offload
no_op_offload.description: Keep host tensor operations on the CPU instead of offloading them to the accelerator.

flash_attn.title: Flash Attention
flash_attn.description: Enable Flash Attention for optimized performance.

parallel.title: Parallel Sequences
parallel.description: Number of parallel sequences to decode (0 = llama.cpp default). Jan reserves no slot of its own: chat, Cowork and background requests all share slot 0 and their KV caches are parked and restored per conversation.

cont_batching.title: Continuous Batching
cont_batching.description: Enable continuous batching (a.k.a dynamic batching) for concurrent requests. Enabled by default, matching llama.cpp.

load_mode.title: Load Mode
load_mode.description: How model weights are read into memory. Auto memory-maps the file unless a device cannot. None reads the weights without mmap (slower load, may reduce pageouts). mlock keeps them in RAM so they are never swapped out, with or without mmap. Direct I/O bypasses the OS page cache where available. Individual models can override this.

lazy_mode.title: Lazy Tensor Reading
lazy_mode.description: Read the rows of large arch-marked tensors (e.g. per-layer embeddings) from disk on demand instead of keeping them in memory. Auto applies it above 4 GiB. Requires mmap, so pick a Load Mode that memory-maps (Auto, mmap or mmap + mlock).

cache_type_k.title: KV Cache K Type
cache_type_k.description: KV cache data type for Keys (default: f16).

cache_type_v.title: KV Cache V Type
cache_type_v.description: KV cache data type for Values (default: f16).

rope_scaling.title: RoPE Scaling Method
rope_scaling.description: RoPE frequency scaling method. "Model default" leaves it to the model; "None" explicitly disables scaling.

rope_freq_base.title: RoPE Frequency Base
rope_freq_base.description: RoPE base frequency (0 = loaded from model).

rope_freq_scale.title: RoPE Frequency Scale Factor
rope_freq_scale.description: RoPE frequency scaling factor. 0 loads the value from the model; 1 forces no scaling.

cache_ram.title: Prompt Cache RAM (MiB)
cache_ram.description: Prompt cache size in MiB (default: 8192, or off for decision models unless changed). -1 is unlimited, 0 disables it.

persist_thread_cache.title: Remember Conversations Between Sessions
persist_thread_cache.description: Keep each conversation's prompt cache on disk so reopening it does not re-read the whole conversation. Restored only when the model, its settings and the llama.cpp build all match what saved it.

thread_cache_size.title: Conversation Cache Disk Limit (MiB)
thread_cache_size.description: Disk budget for saved conversation caches (default: 8192). The oldest are dropped first once it is reached. One long conversation can take hundreds of MiB.

cache_reuse.title: Cache Reuse
cache_reuse.description: Min chunk size of matching prefix tokens to reuse from cache. 0 = disabled.

ctx_checkpoints.title: Context Checkpoints
ctx_checkpoints.description: Maximum context checkpoints kept per slot, which let a shifted context be restored instead of reprocessed.

checkpoint_min_step.title: Checkpoint Minimum Step
checkpoint_min_step.description: Minimum number of tokens between context checkpoints.

swa_full.title: Full SWA Cache
swa_full.description: Use full-size KV cache for sliding-window-attention models (e.g. Gemma). Enable this if such a model reprocesses the entire prompt every turn instead of reusing cache; costs more memory.

kv_unified.title: Unified KV Cache
kv_unified.description: Use a single unified KV buffer shared across all slots. Saves memory when running multiple parallel slots.

kv_unified_per_slot.title: Context Per Slot
kv_unified_per_slot.description: Cap how much of the unified KV cache one slot may use, in tokens. 0 leaves a slot free to fill the whole cache. Only applies when the cache is unified.

reasoning_preserve.title: Preserve Reasoning History
reasoning_preserve.description: Keep the reasoning of every earlier assistant turn in the prompt, not just the most recent one. Only affects models whose chat template supports it, and costs prompt tokens.

keep.title: Keep First N Tokens
keep.description: Number of tokens from the initial prompt to keep when context is shifted. -1 = keep all.
